name: Funny Nurse Mini Sticky Notes (12 Pack)
seoTitle: Funny Nurse Sticky Notes Gift Set
metaDescription: Twelve mini sticky note pads with funny nurse and medical designs. A budget friendly gift for nurses and medical assistants who leave notes all day long.
summary: Twelve little sticky note pads with hospital themed designs, for nurses and medical assistants who live by quick reminders.
whyItWorks: Nurses write things down constantly. Room numbers, a med time, a family member's name, a reminder to call pharmacy back. Sticky notes end up on computer monitors, clipboards, and the back of a badge, so a set with nurse humor printed on them turns an everyday habit into something a little more fun. Mini pads are easy to keep in a scrubs pocket or a desk drawer without taking up space.

With 12 pads in the pack, it also doubles as a handy group gift. Split them among the nurses at a clinic, give a few to a medical assistant who keeps the office running, or leave a stack at the front desk during Nurses Week. Office and clinic nurses who sit at a workstation part of the day may get the most use out of them, though floor nurses use plenty too. It is a small, budget friendly way to say you notice the details they keep track of for everyone else.
goodToKnow: Patient information should never go on personal sticky notes, so these are best for reminders, to do lists, and notes to coworkers.
Check the listing photos for the specific designs and pad sizes included.
Pair with a nice pen or a pen light for a simple desk gift.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a medical assistant?
faq.a: Yes. The set is designed with medical assistants and nurses in mind, and anyone working a clinic front desk or back office can use it.

faq.q: How many people can share this pack?
faq.a: With 12 pads, you could give one to each person on a small team or a couple each to a few close coworkers.
